summary: Celanese Corp filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary Celanese US Holdings LLC issued a notice of redemption for all outstanding 4.777% Senior Notes due July 19, 2026. The redemption is scheduled for June 25, 2026, at a price equal to 100% of principal plus accrued interest to that date. This debt-redemption event reduces outstanding liabilities and underscores the company's capital-management strategy. There is no premium beyond par or break fee, and the mechanics follow the indenture terms. Watch for the actual redemption execution and any impact on Celanese’s leverage ratio or cash position.
